name: Piper PA-25 Pawnee
summary: Piper's single-seat, strut-braced low-wing agricultural monoplane with a high rear cockpit behind the hopper; also widely used as a glider tug and banner tower.

wings: Low wing braced by a single strut each side
engines: Single Lycoming flat-four or flat-six in a slim cowl
fuselage: Single-seat cockpit raised behind the hopper
tail: Conventional tail with a Piper-style fin and rudder

tellTales: Small low-wing crop duster with a strut under each wing
High, aft-set cockpit behind a hopper
Slim flat-engine nose with a tailwheel

confusedWith.howToTell: The Pawnee is a small strut-braced monoplane with a flat engine; the Air Tractor is bigger, cantilever and usually radial or turbine powered.
The Pawnee has a strut under each wing and a slim nose; the Thrush has a cantilever wing and a blunt radial or turbine nose.
Both are strut-braced low-wing sprayers; the Cessna 188 has a tall, swept Cessna fin and a deeper cowl for its larger Continental, while the Pawnee has a slimmer nose.
The Pawnee is a monoplane; the Ag-Cat is a biplane.
